Asset type: one independent 16:9 photoreal cinematic commercial storyboard first frame, C02 K01.
Scene: a glamorous nighttime building entrance, dry charcoal stone floor with subtle reflections, red carpet leading toward bright glass doors at screen LEFT, a dark recessed alcove opening at screen RIGHT. Cinematic warm entrance light and sharp cool photographic flashes. Not a collage.
Exactly six fictional Korean adults, no likeness to a celebrity: STAR, a 40-year-old man with neat side-parted black hair, long cream dinner jacket with tails, matching cream trousers, white shirt and black bow tie; BODYGUARD, a 30-year-old woman with black low ponytail, fitted black suit, white shirt, discreet black earpiece; four fans: F1 woman bob haircut navy shirt carrying a small folded black table, F2 short-haired man gray knit sweater, F3 man olive shirt and glasses, F4 long-black-haired woman beige jacket.
Composition: eye-level medium wide. Star in center-left raises his right hand only to shoulder height, about to wave with charming proud smile. Bodyguard stands forward and to screen right of him, extends her right arm sideways to hold the four fans back; a slim closed black laptop is visibly tucked under her LEFT upper arm. Fans grouped screen right facing the pair, interest still ambiguous. All six distinguishable; star's cream outfit unobstructed.
